instrument.name: 游标卡尺（用户报告；本地编号caliper-01）

notes: Operator reports 0.1 mm distance resolution and no angle instrument. Original geometry reply 197;197;155;155 retained. Subsequent correction confirms tyre contact-centre track and changes rear/front track to 152.9/152.9 mm, measured using vernier caliper; left/right wheelbase remains 197/197 mm. caliper-01 is a locally assigned label, not a manufacturer serial number. Corrections and reaffirmations are not independent repeats. Caliper range/model/accuracy, measurement timestamp, load and vehicle release remain unconfirmed. No serial, flashing, servo or motor command executed by this package. Later operator confirms normal-load wheels-on-ground manual straight rolling and tape measure. Rolling data moved to a separate instrument session; caliper geometry load remains unconfirmed.
